title: Unauthenticated Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in Auction Nudge – Your eBay on Your Site <= 8.4.0 versions. (CVE-2026-61988)
description: An unauthenticated Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Auction Nudge – Your eBay on Your Site versions up to 8.4.0. This vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts without authentication, potentially impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.
